name: cti
description: Cyber threat intelligence skills for a Dataminr/ThreatConnect TIP: natural-language lookup and reporting over CVEs, actors, malware, campaigns and IOCs.

tip_host.title: TIP instance hostname
tip_host.description: Hostname of your Agentic TIP instance, without https:// or a trailing slash (for example yourinstance.threatconnect.com).

tip_api_token.title: TIP API token
tip_api_token.description: Agentic TIP API token (starts with APIV2). Use a read-only role: the intel lookup skill never writes.
